一行は警戒しながら、<r=シャフト>縦坑</r>をゆっくり垂直降下していく。: Maintaining vigilance, the group slowly made a vertical descent down the <r=シャフト>Shaft</r>.
さっきまで視界を埋め尽くしていたタツミヤ鉱結晶の乱立風景は\n徐々に消え失せ、坑: The dense clusters of Tatsumiya ore crystals that had filled their field of vision gradually faded away, with bare rock taking up more and more of the shaft walls.
会長の言う通り、本当に<r=クリスタル・ベルト>煌晶帯</r>から\n次の階層へ: Just as the President had said, it became clear that this was indeed the threshold leading from the Crystal Belt to the next stratum.
敵の反応もなく、一行は静かに次の階層を目指す。: With no enemy signatures detected, the group quietly pushed on toward the next stratum.

思わず、呆然としてしまった。: Without thinking, I stood there stunned.

<r=シャフト>縦坑</r>を降下した先は、大きく開けた<r=ホール>広間</r: Emerging from the <r=シャフト>Shaft</r>, they found themselves in a vastly open <r=ホール>Hall</r> where, astonishingly—a vast night sky stretched out before them.
闇と星粒に囲まれた、３６０度すべてが夜空の世界。\nその光景をなぜか俺は『知って: Encased in darkness and specks of starlight, it was a 360-degree world of pure night sky. For some reason, I felt as though I 'knew' this sight.
いつも見ている夜空には何も思わないのに。: Even though I never felt anything looking at the ordinary night sky.
この場所に来るのは初めてのはずなのに。: Even though this was supposed to be my very first time here.

すごい……星空に囲まれてる……: Amazing... We're completely surrounded by stars...

あのキラキラしているやつ……すべて星……？: Those sparkly things... Are they all stars...?

まさに……自然が見せる芸術ね……: It truly is... a work of art crafted by nature...

ちょっと皆さん、ここへは遊びに来たわけではありませんよ！: Hey, everyone! We didn't come here to play around!
